Agronomy
Agronomy Services in South Central Minnesota That Work as Hard as You Do
Local expertise, quality seed, fertilizer, nutrition, and precision ag tools designed to help you increase yields and manage inputs effectively.
See Agronomy Services
Energy
Energy Solutions for Your Home & Farm
Count on us for propane, refined fuels, tank installation and monitoring, lubricants, and DEF to keep your home comfortable, your farm running smoothly, and your equipment in top condition.
See Energy Services
Feed
Animal Nutrition Solutions for Healthy, Productive Livestock
Dairy, beef, poultry, and swine feed programs backed by local experts to help improve animal health and performance.
Explore Feed Solutions
Grain
Grain Marketing Support to Maximize Every Bushel
Flexible contracts, market insights, and real-time bids help you manage risk and sell grain with confidence.
See Grain Solutions
Equipment
Machinery, Parts & Service for Every Job
Our Ag Service Center in Lafayette is your one-stop shop for farm machinery, construction equipment, grain handling systems, and everything in between.
View Ag Service Center
BCA Products
Fertilizer and Ice Melt
BCA Products delivers custom-blended fertilizers and ice melt solutions, serving lawn care pros, golf courses, and retail distributors with branded and private label products.
Learn More About BCA Products
